## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Configuration now supports multiple config files instead of a single file.
  * Added support for configuration query operations on specified paths.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Enhanced validation for configuration entries with stricter type checking.
  * Improved error messages when configuration loading or parsing fails.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

Shared CLI/config handling changed from a single config path to an array: SharedOptions now exposes `config: string[]` and CLI parsing accumulates repeated `--config` occurrences with type validation. loadConfig now accepts `string[]` plus `withRelPath`, iterates entries (inline JSON, file loads, pseudo-jq queries), and deep-merges or replaces configuration pieces via new `deepMerge` and `processQuery` logic. The `withRelPath` resolver is threaded through bin entrypoints and tests; tests updated/expanded for multi-config stacking and stricter error cases.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

- Attention hotspots:
  - packages/jam/config-node/node-config.ts: entry parsing, deepMerge, processQuery, error messages and merge semantics
  - bin/jam/args.ts: `parseValueOptionAsArray`, changed `parseSharedOptions` signature and validation of repeated options
  - Cross-cutting plumbing: propagation of `withRelPath` through bin/jam/index.ts, bin/tci/index.ts, bin/rpc/main.ts and updated tests

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#654 — introduces workspacePathFix and relative-path resolution used by the new `withRelPath` propagation.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#450 — modifies CLI shared options parsing and overlaps with the `SharedOptions` / `parseSharedOptions` changes.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#627 — touches `packages/jam/config-node/node-config.ts` and relates to changing defaults and config-loading behavior.

```suggestion
function parseValueOptionAsArray<X, S extends string, T>(
  args: minimist.ParsedArgs,
  option: S,
  typeOfX: "number" | "string",
  parser: (v: X) => T | null,
  defaultValue: T[],
): Record<S, T[]> {
  if (args[option] === undefined) {
    return {
      [option]: defaultValue,
    } as Record<S, T[]>;
  }

  const vals: unknown[] = Array.isArray(args[option]) ? args[option] : [args[option]];

  delete args[option];

  const parsedVals: T[] = vals.reduce((result: T[], val: unknown) => {
    const valType = typeof val;
    if (valType !== typeOfX) {
      throw new Error(`Option '--${option}' requires an argument of type: ${typeOfX}, got: ${valType}.`);
    }
    const parsed = parser(val as X);
    if (parsed !== null) {
      result.push(parsed);
    }
    return result;
  }, []);

  return {
    [option]: parsedVals.length > 0 ? parsedVals : defaultValue,
  } as Record<S, T[]>;
}
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->
